clause: Customer identity verification mandatory before account opening
Re-verification of customer identity at periodic intervals not exceeding 2 years for high-risk customers
All payment system data must be stored only in India
Audit trail of all transactions must be maintained for minimum 5 years
Explicit consent from borrower before accessing mobile data
Grievance redressal mechanism with resolution within 30 days
Reasonable security practices for sensitive personal data
Third-party service providers must comply with same data protection standards
